title: Warm Palm-Sugar Ethiopian Pip Gored-Gored
description: Peppery, fluffy, and sweet, this date-night Ethiopian dish is a delight to make and share. Made with palm sugar nam tan pip and wrapped in a lotus leaf.
instructions: Grind the berbere spice mix in a mortar and pestle until well combined.
Heat the ghee or oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the palm sugar nam tan pip and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes.
Add the chopped cilantro, salt, and black pepper. Stir well.
Place a portion of the mixture onto the center of each lotus leaf.
Fold the bottom half of the leaf up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a neat package.
Steam the gored-gored over boiling water for 10-12 minutes, or until the filling is heated through.
Serve warm, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
